name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: slight softness, nothing more (all curves smooth — nothing spikes early).
Light: mild vertical doubling + painting-flattening begins; colors cool.
Common: clear doubling, frame-hold stutter, desaturation toward gray-blue.

Strong: world visibly shrinking inside a dark surround; tunnel forming (late vignette wakes); environmental cubism/scenery-slicing begins — the painting starts looking assembled from large, softly-bounded, faintly mismatched glossy panels (PsychonautWiki's own documented ketamine geometry, milder and less intricate than a psychedelic fractal).

Heavy: full k-hole — scene collapses to a small, flat, contrast-crushed painting swimming in a near-black surround; doubling and stutter are extreme; the panel-slicing is fully present, slowly turning, multicoloured and glossy.
